candidates.change_summary: Return a different bytes32 constant from proxiableUUID so callers receive a value other than ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Remove the body of notDelegated so it never reverts, allowing proxiableUUID to execute on the proxy and return the implementation slot instead of reverting.
Remove the modifier initializer from the initialize function so it can be called multiple times, changing the state initialization path.
Replace __Access_init(_accessControl) with a direct storage write to the accessControl slot, bypassing the onlyInitializing guard and changing the initialization state.
Replace __UUPSUpgradeable_init() with _disableInitializers(), altering the contract's initialization state after the call.
Change the initializer check from `initialized == 0 && isTopLevelCall` to `initialized == 0` (removing isTopLevelCall condition), allowing reinitialization in non-top-level calls.
Replace `$._initialized = 1;` with `$._initialized = 2;` inside the initializer modifier, so the recorded version after initialization differs.

Replace elapsed calculation by setting elapsed = 1 instead of block.timestamp - utilizationData.lastUpdate when block.timestamp > utilizationData.lastUpdate, altering the interest rate multiplier dynamics.

Replace utilization calculation inside the if-block by using IVault(_vault).utilization(_asset) instead of (index - utilizationData.index) / elapsed, which changes the computed utilization fed into _applySlopes.
Replace the condition `if (elapsed != block.timestamp)` with `if (elapsed == block.timestamp)`, flipping which branch executes and thus changing the utilization value used in _applySlopes.
Delete the update of utilizationData.index and utilizationData.lastUpdate inside the if-block, causing subsequent calls to reuse stale index/timestamp and compute different utilization values.
